label: Five runtime adapters over one lifecycle core
detail: Claude emits hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext; Pi imports the same handler in-process and appends via transform; OpenCode plugin mirrors lifecycle. All route through buildSkillAdvisorBriefFromCli (warm daemon -> CLI -> local scorer). Hook budget 2500ms, warm probe 250ms.

label: Layered typed failure taxonomy, all fail-open
detail: Nine typed subprocess error codes; SQLITE_BUSY retry with 75-125ms jitter inside 3s budget; CLI fallback retries on fail_open/degraded+unavailable; hook emits {} on parse/unknown errors; kill switches; diagnostics never affect behavior. Orchestrator defends writes (atomic rename); advisor defends delivery path.

label: Directive dedup suppresses repeat-turn cost only
detail: Content-equality dedup on the static Directives tail per session; lifecycle boundaries force full redelivery. Changed Advisor head re-delivers whole block. Push learned not to resend the invariant half; the variable routing head is never deduped.

label: Prompt-policy fire gate partitions prompts not skills
detail: Fires on explicit markers, work-intent verbs with token floors, length thresholds; suppresses empty/skip/casual. Externalized JSON policy + env overrides. Cheapest scope: removes advisor cost on prompt classes where routing adds nothing, but the full graph is ranked on every fired prompt.

label: Boundary hygiene at locate/read time
detail: 64KB byte-safe prompt clamp; workspace root anchored to real repo root; .skilled/.opencode dual-root discovery requires all three paths from one root (half-migration rejected); Pi capture bounded 32KB/64 sessions.
